decisive_spans.text: color Doppler imaging revealed a vascular signal extending from the periphery into the center of the lesion

response.rationale: The presence of a submucosal mass with a vascular signal extending from the periphery into the center of the lesion is highly characteristic of a GIST. While Glomus tumor also mentions a vascular signal, the specific description of the vascular signal in the vignette strongly supports GIST.
